title: Chapter 56 Go Find Her Later
content:
Chapter 56 Go Find Her Later

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Ao Qing again.

"Ao Qing, you said that your Dragon Clan is going to break off relations with the Phoenix Clan?"

Ao Qing nodded and said firmly: "Master, the Phoenix Clan is too bullying. My young master is being bullied so much, I must stand up for her."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng slowly said: "Can you make the decision for the entire Dragon Clan?"

Hearing this, Ao Qing was silent for a moment, and then said: "Yes, but, Master, I need to go back to the Dragon Clan."

Now, it's time to go back.

And this time, what he has to do is to change the Dragon Clan.

Looking at Ao Qing's firm eyes, Lu Daosheng was slightly surprised.

It seems that Ao Qing is not so stupid. It seems that he has seen Ao Qing's intention. Lu Daosheng smiled and then agreed to Ao Qing's return to the Dragon Clan.

"Ao Qing, don't force it too much. Huangcheng is no worse than the Dragon Clan."

Hearing this, Ao Qing trembled all over, and then nodded heavily.

"Ao Qing knows."

Ao Qing left.

Leaving the deserted city, he headed towards the direction of the Dragon Domain.

He should have taken Lu Xue back with him, but Lu Xue was not in good condition at the moment, so he returned to the Dragon Clan alone.

In the hall, he looked at the direction where Ao Qing was going.

Lu Daosheng sighed.

Lu Daosheng didn't care much about the dragon clan of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm, but Ao Qing insisted on doing so, so he followed Ao Qing's wishes.

It was also a help to Ao Qing.

Then Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and a figure suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

It was a handsome young man.

Although he was wearing tattered clothes, his aura made everyone in the hall feel palpitations.

Who is this person?

Everyone was shocked and confused.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the young man and said slowly: "Go and follow Ao Qing, don't let anything happen to him."

The young man said respectfully: "Yes, Lord City Lord."

Then, the young man disappeared directly on the spot.

No one present could see his trace clearly.

Everyone was silent. It seemed that the Lord City Lord had not only them under his command, but also forces that they were not even aware of.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at everyone again.

"Go down, each of you do your job, don't make any mistakes."

Hearing this, everyone nodded and said: "Yes, Lord City Lord."

After everyone left, Lu Daosheng did not stay for long, but went to Lu Xue's residence.

......

Squeak--

Lu Daosheng pushed the door open.

Suddenly, Lu Xue suddenly got up from the bed.

"Who!"

Seeing Lu Xue's somewhat panicked reaction, Lu Daosheng was immediately heartbroken.

He dared not imagine how Lu Xue had survived these hundred years.

And now, he could only try his best to make up for it.

"Xiaoxue, don't be afraid, it's Dad."

Lu Daosheng slowly walked to the bedside and sat down.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue threw herself into Lu Daosheng's arms.

"Dad, what kind of person is my mother?"

After a moment, Lu Xue suddenly asked.

Lu Xue didn't like the Ice Phoenix Clan, and even hated it a little, but she had the blood of the Ice Phoenix Clan, and her mother was also a member of the Ice Phoenix Clan, which made her very conflicted.

As for her mother, she was also full of curiosity. What kind of person was she?

After hearing Lu Xue's words, Lu Daosheng paused.

At this moment, his mind suddenly emerged a long time ago, when he had just crossed over.

He met a beautiful woman.

The woman smiled beautifully, and there was a feeling of first love.

Although he had never dated her at that time.

The woman looked at him with a smile, her cheeks slightly red as she said, "Daosheng, can we be together?"

"Daosheng, I will protect you in the future."

The feeling of missing him suddenly surged from the bottom of his heart, until Lu Xue's voice pulled him back from his memories.

"Dad, Dad,"

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I will take you to find her in the future, okay?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled and nodded.

"Okay."

After a long time, Lu Daosheng left Lu Xue's room.

After returning to his residence, Lu Daosheng slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

"System."

[Yes, host]

"System, is my wife in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm?"

"Why can't I feel a trace of her breath?"

Even if there is a trace, Lu Daosheng can find some clues based on the trace of that trace of breath.

But Yan Lingyun seemed to have never appeared in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm, without a trace.

[Host, she is not in the Wanling Realm]

"What! System, are you kidding me?"

Hearing the system's answer, Lu Daosheng was a little angry.

When in the Hongmeng Universe, she said she was in the Wanling Realm, but when she arrived in the Wanling Realm, she said she was not. Are you kidding me?

[Host, don't be angry, the system will really not lie to you. Your wife was really in the Wanling Realm not long ago, but she left again recently]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned.

"She went to a higher world?"

[Yes]

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng slowly said: "System, my wife is not just a descendant of the Phoenix Clan, right?"

[Yes]

"Then why is she unwilling to come to see me?"

This time, the system did not answer.

Lu Daosheng looked up at the starry sky, his eyes were a little confused, but then, they dissipated.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng made up his mind.

When Huangcheng is strong enough to leave the Wanling Realm, no matter what happens, he will go to ask the other party for clarification.

Why did he abandon them for so many years?

Why didn't he come back for so many years?

At the same time, in the wilderness.

Countless creatures from all over the Wanling Realm are rushing towards Huangcheng.

At the city gate.

It's still the two brothers of the Zhang family.

Now, their strength has reached the ancient realm.

It may be very weak for the current environment, but in fact, the speed of cultivation is very fast.

After all, it has only been a thousand years since Huangcheng was established.

In a thousand years, most of the practitioners in the Hongmeng Universe may still be below the saints.

But the two of them are not panicked at all.

After all, they have Huangcheng behind them.

And on the city wall, Huang Shou is also sitting there.

At this time, the strength of this city defender is not as simple as in the Hongmeng Universe.

The peak of the ninth level of the earth realm.

What a concept, half a foot has already stepped into the realm of the sky.

Many clan leaders of top clans have just reached the ninth level of the Earth Realm.

"Look, there are people, no, there are, uh, something is coming."

Zhang Hai pointed to the distance and exclaimed.

Looking in the direction, he immediately saw a humanoid creature coming here.

It had three eyes on its head, and it was a member of the Three-Eyed Clan.

"This..."

Walking under the deserted city, the Three-Eyed Clan member was shocked.

I came to see what the so-called human race looked like, but I didn't expect it to be so terrifying.

Just looking at it like this, he felt like an ant.

But at this time, he looked at the two people in front of the city gate.

Immediately, he sneered.

"Are there no people in your human race? You actually sent two ants to guard the gate."

"Or is your so-called deserted city just bluffing?"

Seeing the cultivation of the two Zhang brothers, he regained his defiant look, and his three eyes were full of disdain, obviously looking down on the human race.

Hearing this, the two brothers frowned and said, "If you want to enter the city, you have to pay the entrance fee. If you don't want to enter, get out."

Lu Daosheng has already explained that there is no need to be polite to outsiders.

Hearing this, the three-eyed tribe member was furious.

"What did you say?!"

A pressure of the fourth level of the earth realm was about to surge towards the two Zhang brothers.

However, when the aura reached the deserted city, it disappeared directly.

Suddenly, he was a little shocked.

It seems that this huge city is really not simple.

And at this moment, a blood-colored long sword suddenly appeared in front of him, and the terrifying sword intent pointed directly at him.

"If you don't want to leave, then die."

A voice with a hint of murderous intent came from the tall city wall.

The three-eyed man trembled all over, looked up, and immediately saw Huang Shou sitting on the edge of the city wall.

At this time, Huang Shou looked at him as if he was staring at a dead person.

What a terrifying strong man!

And he is a human.

It turned out that the two people watching the city gate were just a decoy, and the one who really watched the city gate was the one on the city wall.

In an instant, the three-eyed man understood.
